issue_title: [Security] _sanitize_text 未处理 Unicode 双向控制字符 (Bidi override: U+200E-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069)
summary: Added sanitization for Unicode Bidirectional (Bidi) control characters (U+200E-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) in _sanitize_text function to prevent terminal text manipulation attacks.
risks: None - the fix adds additional character ranges to sanitize without changing existing behavior.
